implementation: Flutter adds opt-in, account-scoped native notifications on macOS, Windows and Android for new unread TEXT/DM events while the app is hidden. Notification previews are generic and never include message content. OS permission state is handled where the platform exposes a runtime permission; duplicate events are suppressed locally and across app launches.

checks.name: Notification policy, deduplication, account preference and denied permission tests
checks.observation: All 37 targeted tests passed, including generic preview policy, hidden/enabled gating, duplicate event suppression, per-account preferences and permission denial.

checks.name: macOS release build and startup smoke
checks.command: flutter build macos --release && flutter run -d macos --release
checks.observation: Release app built successfully (83.1 MB), launched through native plugin initialization and was shut down normally. Notification permission was not requested automatically at startup.

checks.name: Android debug build and notification permission merge
checks.observation: Debug APK built successfully after enabling the plugin-required core library desugaring; merged Android manifest contains android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS.

remaining: Physical OS acceptance remains open: macOS permission grant/denial and background delivery; Windows toast registration/delivery on a Windows runner; Android 13+ permission prompt and background delivery on a device.
